_comment: multiple-version line, MC 1.16.5 fabric: the smoke row, and the one row in the matrix with no target mod at all — its JECh jar carries no JEI integration for this version (no JechSearchStorage class, no JEI plugin; the jar holds no JEI entry at all), so only fabric-api and the mod under test ride the run and the harness carries a single scenario (json-smoke). Runs the standalone in-client UI test harness (uitest/mv-1.16.5-fabric, an independent architectury-loom build in this repository) through the three-stage pipeline config->build->test. The harness build stages the JECh jar under test into the run's mods/ folder itself (a production fabric jar is intermediary-named; fabric-loader's dev-mode remapper brings it into the run's namespace) and takes fabric-api as its own remapped Gradle dependency at exactly the pinned version, so jech and fabric-api both carry via=dev-classpath: there is nothing for jt to stage. The row is a harness row since this move (2026-10-15): it declares no ready_when and no world, because the harness's own runner creates and pins its flat level and quits the client when the selection is done. java is 17, and that is the JDK the harness build's Gradle wrapper itself runs on, not the row's client: the standalone backend hands env.java to Gradle as JAVA_HOME, and architectury-loom 1.1 refuses to apply on Java 8 at all (measured 2026-10-16: 'You are using an outdated version of Java (8). Java 17 or higher is required'), while the client stays on the harness build's own toolchain 8 (the machine's azul 1.8.0_492) — the same split envs/1.12.2-forge-*.json documents (java.version 21 for a Gradle 9.3.1 wrapper whose client is on toolchain 8) and the same split the multiple-version checkout itself runs (its 8.1.1 wrapper on JDK 17, its 1.16.5/build.gradle pinning java.toolchain.languageVersion = 8). One consequence worth knowing: env.java is not the client's JDK on a standalone row, so a Java 8 client is a property of that row's harness build, not of this file. The wrapper/toolchain pins are the multiple-version checkout's 1.16.5 fabric module's (loader 0.14.9, api 0.42.0+1.16, plus the two loader libraries that module corrects — see uitest/mv-1.16.5-fabric/build.gradle).
